purpose: Paper-only training mandate for the Fincept firm. It fixes every choice in advance so the agents are graded on process, not on picking trades. It is not a strategy with proven edge: the evidence base scores short-horizon timing between 22 and 52 out of 100.
direction_rule: 1. If analyze_market gives a smart-money long share outside 45-55%, take the side the smart money is net on.
2. Otherwise, on the shortest timeframe: long if price > EMA20 > EMA50 and MACD > 0; short if price < EMA20 < EMA50 and MACD < 0.
approval: The account owner approves each basket's exact legs in chat before execution. No standing approval exists.
